summary: Regression after code-review fixes (AuthContext useCallback/useMemo, IncidentDetail/ReviewIncident/ForgotPassword catch logging, follower_count floor). Re-ran /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with -n 0 => 42/42 pass. Added targeted regression probes: (a) /api/auth/forgot-password returns byte-identical JSON+status for registered vs unregistered emails ('If that email is registered, a reset link has been sent.'), (b) DELETE /api/incidents/{id}/follow is safe when user is not following (returns 200 {following:false}, count stays >=0), and after follow+unfollow+unfollow the follower_count floors at 0, (c) admin login->me->logout->me(401) cycle repeated 3x successfully (memoized callbacks did not break session). Frontend Playwright regression: ForgotPassword UI shows identical generic confirmation for both registered and unregistered emails; admin login/logout repeated 2x works (redirects to /admin and back to /login); citizen confirm-btn goes '(0) -> (1)' and becomes disabled, follow-btn toggles Follow <-> Unfollow; authority ReviewIncident at /authority/incidents/{id} successfully adds internal note (toast 'Internal note added', note persists in staff-only list), assign-dept-select + assign-btn render.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext memoization verified: repeated login/logout cycles work and no stale state. useCallback/useMemo changes are safe.

IncidentDetail/ReviewIncident/ForgotPassword catch blocks now log, which aids debugging without changing user-visible behavior; ForgotPassword still shows identical generic message on failure path (verified).
incidents.py unfollow now uses $max flooring (or equivalent) - verified follower_count never drops below 0 even when DELETE /follow is called while not following.
